# Owned nested carrier factory fixture

A generic class and its public static factory independently declare the same
Object-bounded formal. The input has two complete invariant nominal layers;
the opaque self result retains that same method-owned formal. Source and
SDK-provider profiles compile every recovered unit and compare original
entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen direct, separately compiled,
reflection and method-handle callers run 96 fresh JVM cases twice. They check
input identity without inspection, callback ordering, actual future/null/other
results, allocation counts, exact failures and late list reads/casts. Six wrong
programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls protect the proof. Only
owned fixture code executes; use JDK 21 and release 8 for compilation.
